reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled from a ~600/month baseline (Jun-Jul 2026) to 1180 (Aug) and 1260 (Sep) because a change to the billing import validation rules around August produced systematically wrong bills (H-RULE-CHANGE-MISCONFIG), evidenced by the majority of disputed bills (1785/3025, ~59%) occurring on ACTUAL rather than ESTIMATED reads (E-03), which rules out estimate-substitution/meter-data mechanisms as the dominant cause. Ticket response times remain within the 3.0-day SLA (E-04), so the surge is a billing-accuracy problem at the import-validation step, not a response-capacity problem.
